title: Alert
description: Output of the Alert Agent. Generated when an account crosses the 'high' risk threshold.

account_id.description: The account that triggered this alert.

risk_score.description: The risk score that triggered the alert (copied from the account).

risk_band.description: The risk band (alerts only fire for 'high').

pattern_type.description: The primary suspicious pattern detected. 'none' if flagged by score alone.

priority.description: Alert priority determined by the Alert Agent based on score + pattern + amount.

summary.description: One-line alert summary (e.g., 'High-risk circular transaction pattern detected').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was generated.
